title: WP/15319/1993 - PONDURI BHUSHAIAH GUNTUR DT  Vs SECY. FOOD AND AGRL.(CO.OP) DEPT.HYD
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE, ANDHRA PRADESH
                      AT HYDERABAD
                 (Special Original Jurisdiction)
        THURSDAY, THE SEVENTEENTH DAY OF JUNE
                TWO THOUSAND AND FOUR
                          PRESENT
         THE HON'BLE MR JUSTICE B.PRAKASH RAO
              WRIT PETITION NO : 15391 of 1993

Between:
1.M.J.Ramesh Rao Secretary PACS
  A/oM.J.Nagoji Rao,age 40Yrs.,
  Bathalapalli Mandal & P.O.
  Dharmavaram, Anatapur District.
2. J.Nagabhushanam, Secretary PACS,
   S/o Venkatesu age 42 Yrs.,
   Daduluru, Kanmaganapalli Mandal
   Anantapur District.


                                                        ... PETITIONERS

AND

  The Convenor Dist. Level Committee/ The General Manager
  Dist. Coop. Central Bank Ltd., Anantapur
                                                .....RESPONDENT

       Petition under Article 226 of the constitution of India praying that
in the circumstances stated in the Affidavit filed herein the High Court
will be pleased to call for the records pertaining to RC.No.PS/1/9394,
Dt.4/9/93 on the file of the respondent and set aside the same as illegal
in so far as it relates to the transfer of the petitioners to the societies
mentioned from their societies as illegal and violative of the statutory
provisions and the functions assigned to the Dist. Level Committee in
GO.Ms.No.788 F&A (Coop.III) Dept., Dt.28/4/88 by issuance of a writ of
mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction as the
Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the
case.

Counsel for the Petitioner: MR.G.V.SHIVAJI (not present)

Counsel for the respondent : MR.O.MANOHER REDDY

The Court Made the Following :
 ORDER:


         On 30.04.2004 when the matter was called, none appeared nor

there was any representation. Hence, it was directed to be listed after

vacation. When the matter is called today, none appeared nor there

was any representation.

         Hence, the writ petition is dismissed for default. No order as to
costs.



17-06-2004
klp
